controls.name: C-21d
controls.query:
FROM logs-keycloak.events-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-06-29T00:00:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-07T00:00:00.000Z"
        AND loggerName == "org.keycloak.events"
| STATS events = COUNT(*)
| LIMIT 1
